member.name: LanguageResolver
member.para: The book that ran as English while being German. "Das Mutantenkorps" (15:35:42, 2026-08-03, build 233): detection sampled the file's first probe window, which is 47 s of label music, got en p=0.36, fell back to English, and ran the whole book that way. Whisper, told the audio was English while hearing German, mostly obliged with English renderings - 292 "Chapter N" against 17 "Kapitel N" across the log - so 29 of 30 chapters were still found.

The one chapter it cost. Chapter 25, whose announcement never once came back in English. It was heard, correctly, three times (Re-probe at p=0.81, Scan at p=0.79, Re-scan at p=0.80) and discarded every time, at the cost of a further 40 minutes of hunting a phrase that was already sitting in those passes' own transcripts.
